headline: Phase 2B closes clean-null (again): 0/30 candidates reach DARK_COMPANION_CANDIDATE — 4 resolve to ordinary stellar SB1 companions, 3 are artifacts (1 pulsation, 2 RV/period incoherence), and 23 (77%) are real RV variables stuck at NO_PERIOD_PENDING for lack of a ZTF period.
ranked_table:
NOTE: input batch contained 30 distinct source_ids, not 31 as stated in the task framing — reporting the 30 actually present, not padding to match.

Ranked by M2_min (Msun) descending, then by "how close to actionable" for the periodless majority:

4. source_id=4416914787767626240 | M2_min=0.16-0.26 Msun | P=1.816d (MARGINAL, FAP=0.025, alias-contaminated) | verdict=STELLAR_SB1 | poor RV-fold chi2 (~5-6/dof), 3/8 DESI epochs flagged GALAXY-template (data-quality concern) | weakest of the 4 "resolved" cases — flagged park, not priority

M2_min would be 0.17 Msun even taken at face value.

research_log_row: 2026-07-05 | Phase 2B (DESI RV x ZTF period, dark-companion mass-function screen): 30 candidates processed (batch delivered as "31" but only 30 distinct source_ids present in the record — flagged, not padded). Results: 0 DARK_COMPANION_CANDIDATE, 4 STELLAR_SB1 (ordinary M/K-dwarf-mass companions, M2_min 0.16-0.62 Msun, best-constrained: 1487470319907416832 & 3831414946076844032 with clean eclipse/ellipsoidal-confirmed periods and near-perfect RV folds), 3 ARTIFACT (1 SX Phe/delta-Scuti pulsation mimic [2688492537652631424], 2 cases of RV-incoherent-with-period or single-bad-epoch-driven signal [4420297293556298880, 4419654805103735424]), 23 NO_PERIOD_PENDING (77% of batch — real, highly significant SB1 RV variability with no ZTF-recoverable period; one case, 3785672651021535872, has zero ZTF coverage at all, confirmed genuine gap). No Phase-3 deep-dives dispatched — nothing cleared the dark-companion bar. Lane verdict: current archival ZTF+DESI data is exhausted for this batch; the periodless majority is squarely gated on more DESI RV epochs or Gaia DR4 (Dec 2026) astrometric/spectroscopic orbits, not on more analysis effort.
honest_verdict: No candidate survived as a plausible dark compact companion in this Phase 2B batch — the dark-candidate count stays at 0, extending the project's honest prior (0-2 real in the whole sample) rather than breaking it. Of 30 candidates: 4 resolved to STELLAR_SB1 with ordinary M-dwarf/K-dwarf-mass companions (M2_min 0.16-0.62 Msun, well below any WD/NS/BH threshold), and none of these needed a Phase-3 deep-dive to kill them — the mass function itself was low enough (or, for the weakest one, the period marginal enough) that they never cleared the bar to begin with. 3 more looked superficially like they had a period but died on independent grounds: one is a textbook SX Phoenicis/delta-Scuti pulsator (photospheric pulsation velocity, not orbital reflex motion — exactly the "pulsation mimic" adversarial check the project's Phase-3 protocol exists to catch, except this one failed it immediately rather than needing a dedicated deep-dive), and two had photometric periods flatly contradicted by the RV time-series shape (smooth multi-day drift incompatible with a sub-2-day period; a single outlier DESI epoch with mismatched spectral template driving the whole "detection"). The dominant outcome, 23/30 (77%), is NO_PERIOD_PENDING: real, often highly significant (chi2/dof 100-800) single-lined RV variability with a completely clean, well-tested photometric null from ZTF (Lomb-Scargle + BLS + bootstrap FAP + alias/window-function checks were run essentially every time, and the null was decisive, not marginal, in most cases). This is not an analysis failure — it is a data-sufficiency wall. ZTF's cadence/depth genuinely cannot recover ellipsoidal or eclipse signals for these G~17-18.5 sources at plausible amplitudes, and 5-9 sparse, non-phase-sampled DESI epochs cannot solve for a period on their own. The honest path forward is more RV epochs (DESI follow-up or a future data release) or Gaia DR4 astrometric/spectroscopic orbit solutions (due ~Dec 2026) for this periodless majority, not further mining of the same archival ZTF+DESI data — that lane is exhausted for this batch. Also worth flagging for the pipeline: the task specified 31 candidates but only 30 distinct source_ids were present in the delivered results; and at least 2 candidates carry likely-corrupted or legacy source_ids (2516386605326462848 does not exist in Gaia DR3 — true match by position is 2516386605326602496; 3633111495656814592 is a Gaia DR2 id matching DR3 3633111499952596480) that should be corrected in the upstream candidate list before any further downstream processing.
